notes.v1_05: Shopping: Trick-or-Treat Porch: Make the door and porch boards a muted grey-brown and let slightly more deep blue night show, keeping the lantern glow small. Make the ghost sheet and the cow's white body a clean cool white with soft lilac-blue shadows. Remove the yellow knock lines by the door; keep the characters, the pumpkin bucket and the lantern.
notes.v1_06: Vampire Night: Living Room: Make the walls a cool dusk blue and the rug a smooth soft grey-beige with no fuzzy fibres, keeping the red only on the curtain. Remove the table lamp, the houseplant and the mustard throw, leaving a plain dim wall and the window. Make the bandages a clean white with soft cool grey shadows and softer edges between the wraps.
notes.v1_03: Bridge Crew: Cockpit: Make the spacesuits a soft matte white-grey fabric with a gentle sheen only on the top edges, in place of the chrome. Lighten the dark cabin corners to a mid lavender. Remove the yellow-and-cyan button panel and the blue light strips; keep the red button, the window and the characters.
notes.v1_04: Sky Watchers: Meadow: Remove the fern leaves in the bottom corners and the scattered grass tufts, so the lawn is smooth. Make the grass a slightly deeper, less yellow green and the sky a slightly softer blue with a paler horizon. Keep the characters, the UFO and the trees.
notes.v1_01: Sheriff Pals: Saloon: Make the saloon wall a faded grey-blue instead of red, keeping the red only on the plaid shirt. Paint the plaid as soft, broad colour blocks without crisp lines. Make the boardwalk planks smooth with faint grain; keep the characters, the mug and the hats.
notes.v1_02: Ranch Hands: Farmyard: Draw the hay bale as a few broad, soft clumps in a slightly paler, duller straw colour. Make the bucket soft grey metal with one broad highlight. Lighten the leaf canopy in the top-left corner to the same mid green as the bushes; keep the cow, the rooster and the barn.
